text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday according to the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Paris refuses to deliver visa to leader of Algeria's Human rights league.
- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia says teachers' strike illegal.
- Teachers' strike on the agenda of a meeting of the executive Council.
- National Transitional Council examines draft finance law for 1997 and contests price increases.
- Algerian airline Air Algerie expected to increase fares.
- Islamic Armed Group (GIA) suspected of being behind Paris blast. AL-ALAM-AS-SIASSI
- Members of the National Transitional Council rebuke the government for relying on citizens to fund the treasury.
